customers_say: Customers find the smart lock easy to use and appreciate its appearance, with one noting its premium look. Moreover, the functionality receives positive feedback, with one customer highlighting its flawless real-time alerts, and they like its security features, with one mentioning the manual deadbolt provides extra peace of mind. However, the connectivity aspect is mixed, with some customers noting it connects via Bluetooth while others point out the lack of Wi-Fi gateway support. Additionally, opinions on value for money are divided, with some finding it worth the cost while others express dissatisfaction.

reviews.author: Darshanesh Naringrekar
reviews.title: Good Lock
reviews.body: Service - I’ve ordered this product on Wednesday after a day I’ve received. Same day I received call from installation team. Ramesh Installed the lock next day which was very quick. 10/10 on service. Product - Product is 8/10 lacks function like Wi-fi. Batteries aren’t provided so you’ve to get it from outside. Fingerprint recognition is good feature along with nfc card. Appearance wise also it looks good. Ease of use any can set it up it’s that easy.
